question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing center midfielder, Bob is playing sweeper, and Claire is playing right back.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Claire and Alice trade positions. Then, Claire and Bob trade positions. Finally, Bob and Alice trade positions. At the end of the match, Bob is playing
Options:
(A) center midfielder
(B) sweeper
(C) right back
solution:
Initial: Alice = center midfielder; Bob = sweeper; Claire = right back.
1. Claire and Alice swap: Alice = right back; Bob = sweeper; Claire = center midfielder.
2. Claire and Bob swap: Alice = right back; Bob = center midfielder; Claire = sweeper.
3. Bob and Alice swap: Alice = center midfielder; Bob = right back; Claire = sweeper.
Bob plays right back, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
